visual_action: A desaturated, fast-paced montage of Donald Trump at various public events, such as rallies and formal functions. He is seen smiling, pointing, speaking at a podium, and raising a fist. Text overlays with negative claims about him appear on screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every shot in the video montage and is identified by on-screen text.

cast.name: Donald Trump Jr.
cast.evidence: Appears briefly in the background behind Donald Trump at approximately 0:04.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat, rhythmic song 'Paper Planes' by M.I.A., which plays continuously. The use of a popular, energetic track creates a jarring and critical contrast with the serious negative allegations presented on screen.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different clips of Donald Trump.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a dangerous and corrupt figure with a history of harmful actions, and therefore should not be the 47th President.
intended_effect: To generate opposition to Donald Trump's candidacy by highlighting a list of negative allegations against him.
uncertainty_flags: The identity of the man standing behind Donald Trump at 0:04, who resembles Donald Trump Jr., is not confirmed by authoritative face-ID.
